clauses.text:
By virtue of the authority vested in 
me as President of the United States, Ex­
ecutive Order No. 2458 of September 20, 
1916, entitled “Inter-Departmental Board 
on International Service of Ice Observa­
tion, Ice Patrol and Ocean Derelict De­
struction,” is hereby revoked.
